content.text:
**Finding submitted — deviation (LD).**

- **Responsive clause:** Section 4.2 (¶¶ p0025–p0029) — the "Termination Payment": if *we* terminate, we pay HDI half of twelve months' Net Sales above $800,000, in eight quarterly instalments. Section 1.6 ("terminate … without penalty") and the exclusivity/fee sections contain no other Customer-payable stipulated sums; no service-credit or Vendor-payable LD exists to offset.
- **Why it fails fallback:** the amount is a liquidated sum payable by Customer, measured against Net Sales rather than fees, and is uncapped — well beyond three months' fees under Section 3.1.
- **Cure (fallback, one operation):** new Section 4.2(d) characterising the Termination Payment as an early-termination fee, declaring it our sole liquidated amount, and capping it at three months of Section 3.1 fees. Deleting to the preferred "no LD" position would have orphaned the Section 4 heading and subsections (b)–(c), so the surgical cap was preferred.
